title: fix(console): refuse alias-spelled Setup object lists for a caller the Setup app refuses
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbLjuGcBHnXMKngAM2U7tGSa)_

Fixes #28988

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:普通成员(没有 Setup 应用权限)用别名地址打开对象列表(`/apps/setup/sys_user`、`/apps/setup/showcase_task`、`…/view/ID`、`…/data`,以及会跳转过去的旧地址 `/apps/setup/system/users`)时,现在看到与规范地址 `/apps/com.objectstack.setup/sys_user` 相同的「无权访问此应用」页面。
- 为什么改:以前这些别名地址会套着默认应用(如 Showcase)的顶栏和侧栏显示列表,地址栏却写着 setup,像是进了管理后台;规范地址早已正确拒绝,两种拼写判定不一致。
- 风险与回滚:只改界面判定,服务端读权限不变;管理员不受影响(不发起探测)。记录页 `/apps/setup/OBJECT/record/ID` 按 objectui#12706 的未决产品决定保持可达,审批收件箱的链接不受影响。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx`(`isObjectListAppRoute` 与 `appSurfaceAwaitsVerdict` 新增的 `isSetupObjectListRoute` 一支)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/AppContent.setupObjectListVerdict-28988.test.tsx`,预期 12 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `AppContent` asks the Setup app's access verdict on the object **list** routes under the `setup` alias: `/apps/setup/OBJECT`, `/apps/setup/OBJECT/view/ID` and `/apps/setup/OBJECT/data`. They join the routes that already waited on it (`appSurfaceAwaitsVerdict`: metadata, Setup's root, settings, marketplace). A `denied` verdict draws `app-access-denied`, and nothing of the list mounts. Every other verdict, and an admitted caller (Setup in the list, so nothing is probed), render as before.
- A list route is found by route rank (`isObjectListAppRoute`), the way `preloadAppRouteChunk` and `metadataReadsForAppRoute` already match: the sub-path is matched against `APP_ROUTE_METADATA_READS` plus the host's routes, and only `:objectName`, `:objectName/view/:viewId` and `:objectName/data` count. So a static route (`search`, `reports`) or a host route under the Setup segment (`system/approvals`, `system/users`) is never read as an object list.
- The arm applies only under the `/apps/setup` pseudo-route (`isSetupRoute`). An ordinary unmatched app already reaches the verdict through `requestedAppMissing`, and its flow is unchanged.

## Why

For a member the server refuses the Setup app, `/apps/setup` is a pseudo-route (`isSpecialRoute`), so an unmatched `setup` segment fell back to the launcher's default app instead of asking the verdict. The canonical spelling is an ordinary unmatched app and already drew the refusal. The legacy `/apps/setup/system/users` forwards onto `/apps/setup/sys_user`, so the member reached the list from a documented URL.

## Tests

- New `AppContent.setupObjectListVerdict-28988.test.tsx`, a real `ObjectStackAdapter` over a stubbed `fetch`, as in the #27507 and objectui#12706 files:
  - A refused caller gets `app-access-denied`, no `ConsoleLayout` and no page mounted, on `/apps/setup/sys_user`, `sys_organization`, `showcase_task`, `sys_user/view/all_users` and `sys_user/data`. The one by-name probe is Setup's, and the URL is left as typed.
  - The legacy `/apps/setup/system/users` forwards onto `/apps/setup/sys_user`, which is refused.
  - The package-id spelling draws the same screen.
  - Controls: an admitted caller gets the list under Setup, unprobed; a server without the app (404) keeps the default-app fallback; the record page the approvals inbox links to stays reachable for a refused caller; the host's `system/approvals` route is not read as a list; a list under an app the caller may open renders, unprobed.
- Red on `main`: with `AppContent.tsx` at `ab085a04`, 6 of the 12 cases fail (the five list routes and the legacy redirect). The package-id case and the controls pass there.
- Ablation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, blob restored to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty): the route-rank match replaced by `appSubPath !== ''` (every Setup sub-route refused) reds 5 cases across this file and the objectui#12706 file: both record-page controls, both approvals-inbox controls, and the legacy redirect.

## Acceptance notes

- **The boundary is the claim's.** Record routes under the Setup segment (`OBJECT/record/ID`, its `/edit` and `/page/NAME`, and the `OBJECT/ID` shorthand that redirects to one) stay outside the gate, because the approvals inbox links members there and objectui#12706 left that open as a product decision. `OBJECT/new` (the create form) is not a list route and is also left as it was; it still renders under the default app for a refused caller. Noted, not filed.
- **The card's second symptom is not the same verdict.** `/apps/com.example.showcase/system/settings` shows a member the empty settings hub because the member may open Showcase: the app verdict is `granted` there, and #27507 pins that route as rendered, unprobed (`the settings route under an app the caller may open renders the page, unprobed`). It is reported to the seat as an out-of-scope finding, not fixed here.
